result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The full suite passes offline (607 tests, 0 failures).

**Change:** `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (around line 6517). I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the purchase-order subquery, the same filter the quarterly and weekday purchase-order reports use.

No existing test covers this method, so I did not add one. The example in the task (Anna 2, Bob 1) is not checked by a test. I did not change `findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry` or `findPurchaseOrdersByCountry`, which have the same gap but are outside this task. Nothing is committed.
